title: omsstats v1
$comment: Re-derived from the 29 Aug 2026 production sample and UNCHANGED by it - all three production records validate as written, including timespan as an integer. The only edit is to the previous $comment, which claimed this schema 'requires canonical ts.processor input'. That is now wrong twice over: the field is ts.server, and the old ts.converter rejection was removed because production sends ts.converter on every omsstats record.
